text: Shannon's source coding theorem gives entropy its operational meaning: H(X) is exactly the optimal rate, in bits per symbol, for the lossless ___ of an i.i.d. source.
explanation: The source coding theorem states that H(X) is the optimal lossless compression rate — no code beats entropy, and codes approaching it exist (via Kraft/Huffman). This ties the abstract measure to the concrete task of data compression.
